decisions.reason: The support service for dental assistants builds on the firm's core strength in customer service and strengthens retention of the large installed base, so it meets aspirations and triggers no search for other uses of its resources.

The materials management module is only mentioned on the website, so its results are still uncertain, but it extends the core software at low marginal cost and the firm's slack in a growing industry lets it carry the module while it matures.

Secure KIM messaging is a regulatory telematics requirement for German dental practices and is actively updated (KIM 1.5), so it meets aspirations and is integral to the firm's digital health-IT direction.
